target_customer: Chemical manufacturers and industrial biotech groups that could replace chemical synthesis with enzymes
problem: Developing an enzyme takes years of trial and error. Ligo builds deep-learning models that aim to design enzymes for specific reactions in days.
business_model: Model and tooling company for enzyme design, commercial model not found (YC page implies selling designs or tools to chemical makers)
product_category: Generative AI for enzyme and protein design

founders.name: Ed Harris
previous_startups: Bootstrapped food-market startup in Guadalajara, Mexico, reached 1M USD annual revenue (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Worked in three synthetic biology labs at Oxford per YC page.

founders.name: Emily Egerton-Warburton
founders.background_notes: YC page cites biotech startup work on bacterial biofuels and vaccine design; employers not named.

founders.name: Arda Goreci
founders.background_notes: Google Cloud Research Innovator for computational biology per YC page.

competitors.name: Basecamp Research (ZymCTRL)
competitors.what: Open-source generative AI tool for enzyme design released with the Ferruz Laboratory
competitors.traction_then: Released June 2024 on Hugging Face and a partnership with P&G for cold-water enzymes (date of partnership not stated)

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing functional enzymes from scratch needs generative protein models plus wet-lab validation; research-grade, handled by a team with Oxford biology and ML backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Model quality and experimental data could create a moat, but the field has open-source models (ZymCTRL) and the company itself open-sourced a reimplementation of a DeepMind model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established enzyme AI companies existed in 2024. No acquisition or copying of Ligo found.

market_need_then: The YC page says the 6 trillion USD chemical industry produces about 20 percent of industrial greenhouse gases and enzymes are a cleaner route but slow to develop; no customer spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ligo.bio; no acquisition story found. Name is easily confused with Laigo Bio and the physics LIGO observatory.

identity.logo: Plain letter L mark per a directory listing
identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific, plain; research notes blog at research.ligo.bio

branding.community_and_virality: A Sustainable Times profile says the founders conceived the idea at a pub in Oxford in 2021 after AlphaFold 2; the company's open-source reimplementation of a DeepMind model drew attention.

brand_strength.rationale: Some press and developer attention for the open-source model, but the name is unexplained and confusable.

outcome_analysis: Ligo Biosciences joined YC S24 with a four person research team, got press attention for an open-source reimplementation of a DeepMind structure model, and remains active with no verified public round beyond aggregator mentions of about 500K USD. The outcome is open: the science is hard and well funded rivals exist, but no failure or exit news was found.
notes: Aggregators disagree: Startup Intros and Standout list 500K USD (Initialized Capital, YC), Extruct lists 125K USD in 2024-08 plus a pre-seed, VCBacked lists a seed dated 2026-01, Caplight 2024-09. None confirmed by a primary source, so no round recorded. The DeepMind model reimplementation is from a search summary of a directory. Not to be confused with Laigo Bio.
